findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "ask" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: precheck, precheck_bulk, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile, get_benchmark · Public sink: precheck_bulk, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run, get_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: precheck, precheck_bulk, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile, get_benchmark · Public sink: precheck_bulk, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run, get_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "precheck" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
